Conclusion: the silence is not specific to the Linux kernel or its config.
The known-good SLM-OS image on the restored card is equally silent on this
console, with the capture started right after power_on returned. Either
pi-5-1 is not booting from the card, or the console path (RP1 UART0 on
GPIO 14/15 -> lab adapter -> ser2net) is not carrying data. Neither can be
told apart through labctl from here. The litmus spec was not run on Pi 5.
